Dialogs.Dialog: Sure, come in. Come to think of it, it's been a while since you came over.
Yes, come on in. It's been a while, so the room might look a little different.
Welcome home, that was a long business trip... Just kidding.
Come on in. Thanks for coming again.
Sure, come in. You know your way around by now, I guess.
As expected... your room is so neat, ▲高嶺＊＊▲.
No, actually I worked hard cleaning yesterday. There, I said it.
I see. But my room... well, no point comparing.
...Is that how boys are？ They don't mind if it's messy？
Well, guys do have that messy image...
Then maybe next time I'll come clean it up...
It's strange... I'm in my own room, but I can't relax...
Maybe. If you could relax more, like it was your own room...
Then try closing your eyes？ Maybe you'll feel like you're in your own room？
No good. It... smells too nice.
Hmm... it smells like your room, ▲高嶺＊＊▲.
Or rather, maybe it's your scent, ▲高嶺＊＊▲.
Geez, that's not it... Wrong answer.
Actually, I spilled tea yesterday. I was worried the apple tea smell was still here.
So you always sit in that chair to study, ▲高嶺＊＊▲.
It's kind of small and cute.
Small... is it？ I've used it since I was little, so maybe.
Hmm, and then that bed over there...
No, don't inspect everything like that？ Geez.
Your own room really is the most relaxing.
My legs are fine... but I'm a little sleepy, maybe.
Why not lie down a bit？
I can't do that... It'd be a waste to sleep when you're here.
(...Well, of course she can't sleep with me here.)
Come to think of it, you don't have a TV in your room, ▲高嶺＊＊▲.
No... Do most people have a TV in their room？
Who knows？ It's handy to have one... You can just leave it on when you're bored.
I've never really felt I needed one... There's lots to do even without a TV.
Huh... a life without TV, that might be interesting.
Yes, when you're bored, you can call me... okay？
Just thinking, you're in my room.
Well, a guy who's not usually here is sitting in the place you spend every day.
Yes. I wish you'd always just sit right there.
Haha, am I a stuffed animal？
What a beautifully patterned carpet... I'd better not spill anything.
Um... I think it was ordered from a designer in Belgium.
Belgium？ Huh, I don't really get it, but that's amazing.
I don't know the details either... Papa said it's a pretty old piece.
Yeah, I'd better be careful not to get it dirty.
Ah... don't look at my desk too much.
If you say that, it makes me even more curious.
No. There might be things I forgot to put away.
No, if you look closely, there are lots of messy spots in the room.
Lately classical literature has been fun... I've been buying books and reading them.
Huh, I never thought of buying classics to read...
The romances of people long ago are interesting too.
...Having someone look at my bookshelf feels like they're seeing inside my head...
(So... when ▲高嶺＊＊▲ looks at my bookshelf, she's seeing inside my head...)
She's good. It wouldn't look out of place in a museum.
My aunt would be so happy to hear that. But it's just a hobby, she says.
She paints a lot, so next time you come, there might be a different one.
...It's nice sometimes, being quiet like this.
Because it really sinks in that we're alone together.
Huh, that's manga. Wasn't that forbidden？
It's not mine, I borrowed it from a boy in class.
Ah, geez, don't be jealous. We have to copy manga art in art class. It's for that.
Being in your room makes me a little nervous, ▲高嶺＊＊▲.
Yes, but I'm nervous too, so we're even.
Will we get used to it someday and not be nervous anymore, I wonder...？
Who knows？ I don't think I'll be used to it for a while...
Me neither. And somehow, I kind of like this nervousness... Is that weird？
No, it's pretty wallpaper, but that one spot is torn.
No, I looked after one for the neighbors for a day. It's a memory, but... I should fix it.
Don't you listen to music in your room, ▲高嶺＊＊▲？
Hmm, not much, I guess. Why？
You know, like playing music while you study.
Studying while listening to music？ I'm not that coordinated, so I don't think it'd work.
I see... One thing at a time. Impressive.
Is it？ I think being able to study while listening to music is more impressive.
Huh, you put stickers on your calendar.
Yes, a racket is a match day, a basket is going out, and...
Anyway, it's a nice room. Neat. It feels like a room that's loved.
Thank you. It's my favorite, so I'm happy to hear that.
So you really do love it.
Yes, I got it when I started elementary school... I was really selfish then. Papa got mad, but in the end he gave in.
Geez, this is kind of embarrassing.
(So her dad is weak against ▲高嶺＊＊▲'s selfishness too.)
You can see the road out front from your room, ▲高嶺＊＊▲.
Yes. I've seen you walking by from this window.
Right, it was funny how you didn't notice. It was kind of cute.
Um. My room... what do you think of it？ Like it？ Hate it？
Of course I like it. Why？
A room shows a person's personality, right？ So I wondered what you thought.
Then all the more. There's no way I'd hate it.
Geez, such a smooth talker. But thank you.
Oh, I know, let's look at our album.
Yes, I want to see it too. Wait a sec.
The album？ I'd rather do something else...
Okay, the album next time, then.
Hehe, we took this picture too.
Kind of nostalgic. I remember that time well.
It's strange, it already feels nostalgic.
Do you remember this？ I haven't forgotten.
Right, right... we took this one too.
That's from the other day. Yes, it came out well.
This... ah, from the other day.
Hey, we took this one a little while ago, right？
This one was... from the other day, right？
This is from the other day. You love taking pictures, don't you.
Yes, I think it's nice. Do you like it？
I think I like this picture. What about you？
Yes, it came out well. Hehe.
So the picture from that time came out like this.
Is this how I look to you, I wonder... Just kidding.
When you take my picture, I feel like I have a nicer expression.
The best shot, I think... Just kidding.
You're good at taking pictures. ...I might start to like having my picture taken.
From our first shrine visit. What I wished for then... Hehe♪
This is from Valentine's... My heart was pounding...
Ah, the White Day picture. I'm not grinning, am I？
This is a Christmas picture. It was a cold day... but I was with you... so.
A birthday picture... Will you keep celebrating with me from now on？
A picture from your birthday. I was so happy we celebrated together.
The precious day we started dating. Whenever I look at this, I'll remember it.
I remember this date well... It's a precious memory.
It became a precious one. My treasure...
It was a special date... so I'm happy it's saved in a picture like this.
Let's keep making lots of memories.
Let's keep adding more photos and memories.
Phew... my heart feels so full.
They're all memories with you, so each one is precious.
When there are more pictures, let's look at them together again.
Sometimes I open the album alone... but looking through it together and talking is more fun.
I'm counting on you from now on, my personal photographer... Just kidding.
I'll get a new album ready, so keep taking lots of pictures, okay？
We're who we are now because of our memories...
We remembered so much. What kind of pictures will we add from here？
Hey, let's study together or something.
Yes, sure. Let's do our best together？
Yes... I should study, but I'd rather not right now.
Hey, can I take a picture？
Let's look at the pictures you took？
Hey, let's study for the test？
I see... Yes, then never mind.
Hey, do you have your camera with you now？
Sure. Let me take a shot
I'll go get us refills. Wait a bit.
(...On my own, I don't know what to do with myself.)
Oh, Manaka. If it's tea, Mama will make it.
Seems we have a guest. Mama would like to say hello？
Maybe another time... Geez, I'll make it.
What's this, someone seems to be here... A friend？
Yes, hello. This is the Takane residence.
No, my father isn't home yet... Yes.
...Understood, I'll let him know. Thank you very much for calling.
Oh, Manaka-chan. I brought the community notice board.
Thank you. Sorry for the trouble.
I saw you, Manaka-chan. You were walking with a boy the other day, weren't you？ Your boyfriend？
Eh!? No！ Ah, I mean, he is, but...
I hid the shoes by the front door. It'd be trouble if Papa found them.
Hey, Manaka. This friend who's over... How are you two, um...？
Do you get along？ Ah, no, you're friends, so of course you get along...
I don't get it... You're being weird, Papa.
(▲高嶺＊＊▲'s dad is worried about me...)
Excuse me. I'm going around telling folks about some great deals.
I see... I'm sorry, but no thank you.
Don't make such a scary face, miss, couldn't you just... Is your mother home？
(▲高嶺＊＊▲ is tough at times like this...)
Manaka-chan？ I made too many side dishes... I thought you might like some.
Thank you. I'll gladly take them.
Thank YOU, for the sweets you always give me. The boyfriend who gets to eat those is a lucky man.
Miyoshi-san？ Why all of a sudden...
I was nearby. I had a hunch and came by... Did I guess right？ He's here？
Geez... what are you talking about.
Hehe, well, sorry to bother you！
...Don't look around my room too much, okay？
I'm trying to decide what to wear on our next date. Would you help me choose？
I see, okay then. Don't be disappointed on the day.
(If I see it now, I'd have less to look forward to.)
Thank you. Then wait a moment.
What do you think of this outfit？
I'm glad. Then this is a candidate. ...Will you look at others too？
Is this kind of thing your taste？
Really？ Then maybe I'll go with this...
Hmm... like, what kind of thing？
Okay, got it. I'll go change.
I see... I'll look for one, then.
Like this... what do you think？
Sorry to keep you waiting. Tell me honestly what you think？
I tried on so many, maybe you can't decide...
Yes, I knew you'd like that kind.
I see... So that's it. Okay, I'll think about it.
I see... Can't be helped. ...What should I do.
I wish we could be together forever...
Oh no, it's already this late？
You're right, I should really head home.
Yes... Then I'll see you out.
Are you really going home already？ A little longer together... no？
Really？ I'm so glad... I'm happy.
Then... let me see you out.
Come on in. It might be a little messy.
No, it's not... Well, sorry for intruding.
This might be the first time I've invited you over.
Yes, it is. So I'm a little nervous.
Comfortable？ Impossible. I think my heart will race no matter how many times I come.
I'll make the tea, so sit down.
Um... do I even have any？ It's fine, I'll do it.
Don't you get lonely living alone？
Hmm, I'm used to it. Besides, you come over like this, ▲高嶺＊＊▲.
...Yes. If you get lonely, I'll always be by your side... Just kidding.
Hey, what do you do when you're alone？
Nothing special. Texting, thinking about tomorrow's plans, reading web magazines...
(...Maybe I think about ▲高嶺＊＊▲ all the time.)
Maybe I'll turn on the TV.
Huh... ah, right, you can't really watch it at home.
Yes, but just a little is fine...
Watching for a long time isn't good for you... You be careful too, okay？
Oh, right. Can I check under your bed？
I don't really know why, but everyone in the tennis club said I might find something interesting...
Those guys... Under the bed isn't organized, so another time.
Okay, got it. Then I'll look forward to it.
Sorry, looks like the alarm was set wrong.
So this is the sound you wake up to every morning.
Yeah, well, sometimes I wake up, sometimes I don't.
Geez... Hehe, but I'm glad I got to hear it.
Yes... But quiet is kind of nice too.
Yeah. When it's just the two of us, ▲高嶺＊＊▲.
If you're lonely, contact me anytime.
Ah, contact me even if you're not lonely, okay？
The chair at my desk... or the floor there...
Then, when you're on the phone with me？
Because sometimes I picture you while we're on the phone... I want to check my answer.
It's already so late. When I'm with you, sometimes I wonder if the clock is broken...
I'm checking whether it's really moving like it should.
Hey... don't you hear someone's voice？
But... listen, faintly, from inside the wall.
Inside？ ...Maybe it's the TV next door？
Ah, right. Someone else lives next door. Then you're not lonely.
(That's one way to look at it...)
Cooking for yourself must be hard.
Yeah, but I eat out and stuff.
Then, takeout from Winning Burger too？
Well, it's not like I never do.
I don't have that much stuff.
Then, a dresser there... and a study desk...
I was imagining if I lived here too. But a bed wouldn't fit...
Do you keep tennis gear here？
Yeah, of course. But not much. Our club's pretty laid-back, as long as it's fun...
...And the rest is practicing hard and winning matches！
Hehe, let's do our best together？
Your room doesn't have anything extra...
Well, isn't that how guys' rooms are？
I see, it's different from a girl's room.
With dolls and stuffed animals, it'd be livelier.
Yes, when I was little, I slept with stuffed animals too...
(I want to be a stuffed animal...)
Can I look at your bookshelf？
When you put it like that, it's kind of embarrassing...
(I can't say no when ▲高嶺＊＊▲ asks...)
Looking at your room... it's fun imagining your daily life.
What you ate yesterday, when you last cleaned, whether you're doing laundry...
You sound like a nagging sister-in-law, ▲高嶺＊＊▲.
Are they？ Isn't that still acceptable？
You're an athlete, so keep your nails trimmed. I'll cut them.
It's fine, I'll do it myself.
Really？ Then, have you cleaned your ears lately？ Shall I do it for you？
(That's got nothing to do with being an athlete... Does she just want to take care of me？)
Are you particular about your room's interior？
The other day I heard about newlyweds who had a huge fight over decorating. That's why.
Ah, you did laundry. Gym clothes, tennis wear, your restaurant uniform... All kinds of you.
I don't look much different in any of them.
I don't think so. Hey, try on that restaurant uniform？
Sorry. Dozing off in your room...
No, it's fine. It means you're that relaxed.
Maybe that's it. Yes... I like this room.
I bought a new game. Let's play together.
A game？ Yes, sounds fun. What kind of game？
Hmm... I'd rather do something else right now.
Can I do it？ Teach me properly, okay？
Okay. If I'm playing, I won't lose.
Are you sure？ I'll win again, you know. Just kidding.
If possible, I'd like to do something else.
That game... is too hard for me.
I bought a DVD. I thought we could watch it together.
I'd like to do something else...
Yes, I want to see that.
If you recommend it... maybe I'll watch it.
Sorry, can we pick something else？
That went by so fast... I got totally absorbed.
I see, so there are movies like this. I might've learned something.
I bought a new CD. Let's listen together.
Sure. What are we listening to？
That song just now was lovely... I've fallen for it.
Hey, I want to play a game.
Oh, I know, show me a DVD.
I see... It's not like I absolutely have to...
Fun times always end so quickly.
Yes, I was waiting for you to say that... Just kidding.
Sorry, I really have to go home...
Actually... I don't want to go home yet. Just a little longer？
Ah, you have your "I'm hungry" face on... Right？
I learned a new dish. Will you eat it？
If you like, shall I make something？
Want to go out to eat？
Got it. Look forward to it.
Understood. Then shall I go all out？
Sorry, if you ask so suddenly...
It's fine, sorry for asking. Let's go eat out.
And I expanded my repertoire just for you...
Is there anything you want to eat？
In the mood I'm in... here.
There we go. Okay, I'll start.
I wanted to set the mood. Um, I'll start？
If there's anything you want to eat, tell me？
I've made it before, but... if you want it, I'll do my best.
That dish is a first for me... I'll give it a try.
Here you go. Did it turn out good？
Hup... making sweets takes some muscle.
Thanks for waiting. Made with love▼
Matching dishes with mine. Let's eat together♪
Hey, what other dishes would you like to try？
Um... I'm sorry. I broke the faucet in the bathroom...
Sorry, it's been acting up... Did your clothes get wet？
What do I do... Can I borrow your shower？
Mm, I don't know. I have a little chill... I think I got cold.
Are you okay？ Why not take a shower？
A shower？ Yes. Then I'll borrow it.
You got pretty wet. You'll catch a cold like that, so go take a shower.
Yes, right... Then I'll take you up on it.
Um, my clothes... could you lend me something...？
Is this really all you have？
Ah... come to think of it, I might have something else...
Geez, please. Don't be mean at a time like this...
Sorry. I'll get you something else right away.
Borrowing the bath at someone else's house... really is nerve-racking.
Don't look too much. It's kind of... um...
A girl dripping wet is extra pretty, huh！
Haha, I want to be that water.
Pervy water like that gets wiped off right away.
(Then I'd settle for being the bath towel...)
Thanks for waiting. Hot Manaka, all done. Just kidding▼
Sorry for going first. You're cold too, right？ Why not warm up？
